metadata.prompt: A small red sailboat on a calm blue lake, distant green hills, soft morning light, realistic photograph.
metadata.generator_policy: Fresh CPU torch.Generator with the same seed for every request; one generator draws the batch of outputs
metadata.timing_scope: Omni.generate wall time: prompt encoding, denoising, VAE decode and output transport; excludes startup and PNG writing
metadata.memory_scope: Worker-reported peak reserved MiB, not the previous operator allocated-increment metric
limitations: One model, one prompt and one seeded batch; pixel equivalence does not establish general image quality.
Pipeline profiler adds synchronization; diagnostic timings are not scored.
Klein denoises inline, so its built-in profiler has no diffuse stage; use separate transformer hooks for DiT attribution.
